# Renaming a bare name prefers the top-level function over a same-named method.
# Here insertEvent exists both as a package-level func and as a *Tx method.
exec gorelo apply 'insertEvent=txInsertEvent'

# The top-level function is renamed.
exec grep -F 'func txInsertEvent()' tx.go

# The method declaration is left untouched.
exec grep -F 'func (t *Tx) insertEvent()' tx.go
! exec grep -F 'func (t *Tx) txInsertEvent()' tx.go

# The method call site is left untouched, the function call site is renamed.
exec grep -F 't.insertEvent()' tx.go
! exec grep -F 't.txInsertEvent()' tx.go

# Sanity: the result still compiles.
exec go build ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.21
-- tx.go --
package main

type Tx struct{}

func (t *Tx) insertEvent() {}

func insertEvent() {}

func useThem() {
	insertEvent()
	var t Tx
	t.insertEvent()
}

func main() {}
